quarterly_data.signal: Unimicron MOPS filing (workplace accident): at about 2:34 pm on 10-13-2026 an employee at the Yangmei Plant 1 was caught in a machine while repairing it and died despite emergency treatment; the Taoyuan City Government labor inspection office immediately imposed a partial work-stoppage order, and any fine is not yet determined. Company: production and operations are currently not affected; it is cooperating with the investigation to clarify the cause and draw up preventive measures.
